name.description: Optional profile name. Reuse an existing name to replace its model or effort; the harness and resolved model form the default name.

harness.description: Installed worker harness: opencode, pi, codex or claude.

model.description: Model ID or loose model name to resolve against the live harness model list.

effort.description: Optional model reasoning or thinking effort.

machines.description: Optional machines the profile is for. Empty checks every online machine with the harness.

test.description: Run a short real start to test the model before saving. False only checks the live model list.
